units.source_text: 女子给人的印象洁净得出奇，甚至令人想到她的脚趾弯里大概也是干净的。

en.t: The woman gave an impression of almost uncanny cleanliness, so much so that even the spaces between her toes seemed likely to be clean.

units.source_text: 岛村不禁怀疑起自己的眼睛，是不是由于刚看过初夏群山的缘故。

en.t: Shimamura could not help doubting his own eyes, wondering whether it was because he had just looked at the mountains in early summer.
